function.name: get_todo
function.description: Gets one canonical todo by exact ID. Use after search and before ambiguous or destructive actions.

function.name: get_reflection_evidence
function.description: Returns evidence for a daily, weekly, monthly, or custom range. todo_candidates and memory_candidates are all that got done or captured in it; todos and memories are the selected subset, often empty.

start_date.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD start date for custom ranges, otherwise null

end_date.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD end date for custom ranges, otherwise null

life_area_ids.description: Life areas to include; empty means all

category_ids.description: Categories to include; empty means all

function.name: get_conversation_context
function.description: Reads canonical user and assistant messages surrounding a conversation search hit. Use the threadId and objectID returned by personal_data_search; tool traces and provider metadata are never returned.

thread_id.description: Thread ID returned by a conversation search hit

message_id.description: Message objectID to center the context around, or null for the latest messages

limit.description: Maximum number of canonical messages to return

function.name: list_life_areas
function.description: Lists the current user-defined life-area classifications and their IDs. Use this before assigning a non-default classification.

function.name: list_todos
function.description: Never the first tool in a turn. Search the todo index first, including for status questions and full listings, and use this only when that search already ran and left the answer incomplete.

parent_id.description: Parent todo ID for listing subtasks, or null

due_from.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 lower bound or null

due_to.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 upper bound or null

function.name: create_todo
function.description: Creates a todo and optional subtasks. Call only after an Algolia semantic duplicate check found no matching existing todo.

life_area_id.description: Work, Personal, Side Project, or null only when genuinely ambiguous

parent_id.description: Parent todo ID when directly creating a subtask, otherwise null

reminder_at.description: Primary RFC 3339 reminder time or null

extra_reminders.description: Additional RFC 3339 reminder times or null

due_at.description: Subtask RFC 3339 due time or null

function.name: update_todo
function.description: Updates one unambiguous todo using an ID and patch. Read current state first when the ID came from search. Null patch values mean unchanged; clear_fields explicitly clears nullable fields.

title.description: New title or null for unchanged

notes.description: New notes or null for unchanged

priority.description: New priority or null for unchanged

category_id.description: New category ID or null for unchanged

life_area_id.description: New life area ID or null for unchanged

parent_id.description: New parent ID or null for unchanged

due_at.description: New RFC 3339 due time or null for unchanged

reminder_at.description: New RFC 3339 primary reminder or null for unchanged

extra_reminders.description: Full replacement additional reminders or null for unchanged

clear_fields.description: Nullable fields to set to null; empty when none

override_user_classification.description: True only when the user explicitly asked to replace a user-selected life area

function.name: set_todo_status
function.description: Sets only a todo's canonical status.

function.name: delete_todo
function.description: Deletes one exact todo. Call only after resolving ambiguity and receiving explicit user confirmation.

function.name: get_memory
function.description: Gets one canonical memory by exact ID. Use after retrieval and before update or delete.

function.name: create_memory
function.description: Creates one non-sensitive fact, note, or journal memory. Call only after an Algolia semantic duplicate check found no matching memory.

title.description: Short title naming the subject, written from the content and never empty

mood_label.description: Mood in the user's own words, or null when they were asked and gave none

mood_score.description: Mood score from 1 to 5, or null when the user was asked and gave none

life_area_id.description: Work, Personal, Side Project, or null only when genuinely ambiguous

occurred_at.description: When the remembered event happened as RFC 3339, or null

review_worthy.description: Whether this Work memory should be evidence for a performance review

function.name: update_memory
function.description: Updates one unambiguous memory using an ID and patch. Null patch values mean unchanged; clear_fields explicitly clears nullable fields.

kind.description: New kind or null for unchanged

title.description: New title or null for unchanged

content.description: New content or null for unchanged

mood_label.description: New mood label or null for unchanged

mood_score.description: New mood score or null for unchanged

category_id.description: New category ID or null for unchanged

life_area_id.description: New life area ID or null for unchanged

occurred_at.description: New RFC 3339 occurrence time or null for unchanged

review_worthy.description: Whether this is review evidence, or null for unchanged

tags.description: Full replacement tags or null for unchanged

clear_fields.description: Nullable fields to clear; empty when none

override_user_classification.description: True only when the user explicitly asked to replace a user-selected life area

function.name: delete_memory
function.description: Deletes one exact memory. Call only after resolving ambiguity and receiving explicit user confirmation.

function.name: get_review_evidence
function.description: Returns fiscal-quarter evidence, where Q1 begins February 1. todos and memories are the Work-scoped set a draft may quote; todo_candidates and memory_candidates cover every life area.

year.description: Calendar year in which the fiscal quarter starts

function.name: get_agenda
function.description: Gets todos and reminders for an inclusive local date range.

function.name: create_reminder
function.description: Creates a primary or additional reminder for an exact todo. Resolve the date-time before calling.

reminder_at.description: RFC 3339 reminder time with explicit offset

slot.description: Whether to use reminder_at or append to extra_reminders

function.name: list_reminders
function.description: Lists todo reminders in an inclusive RFC 3339 interval.

function.name: update_reminder
function.description: Moves one exact reminder to a new time after resolving which reminder the user means.

reminder_at.description: New RFC 3339 reminder time with explicit offset

function.name: delete_reminder
function.description: Deletes one exact reminder after explicit user confirmation.

function.name: list_jira_boards
function.description: Lists Jira boards on the connected site. Read-only. Set include_columns to also get each board's real column names and the status IDs behind them, so a phrase like "in review" becomes a filter.

name_filter.description: Partial board name to match, or null for all boards

project_key.description: Restrict to boards of one Jira project key, or null

include_columns.description: True to resolve each board's columns and the status IDs in them; costs one extra request per board

function.name: list_jira_issues
function.description: Lists Jira issues matching exact filters. Read-only. Pass board_id from list_jira_boards, status_ids from that board's columns, and "me" or an accountId for assignee. Jira issues are not local todos.

board_id.description: Board ID from list_jira_boards, or null to search the whole site

assignee.description: "me" for the connected account, otherwise an accountId from list_jira_users. Usernames and email addresses are rejected by Jira

project_key.description: Jira project key such as PLATFORM, or null

status_ids.description: Numeric status IDs from a board's columns, or null. Status names are not unique across workflows, so always filter by ID

text.description: Free text to match in summary, description, and comments, or null

updated_within_days.description: Only issues updated within this many days, or null

function.name: get_jira_issue
function.description: Gets one Jira issue by its key, such as ABC-123, including its description as plain text. Read-only. Set include_recent_changes when the question is what moved rather than what is open.

key.description: Jira issue key such as ABC-123

include_recent_changes.description: True to include recent status, assignee, priority, and resolution transitions

function.name: list_jira_users
function.description: Resolves a name or email to a Jira accountId, the only form Jira accepts. Read-only. An empty result means the lookup could not be confirmed, not that the person does not exist.

query.description: Display name or email address to match

function.name: list_confluence_spaces
function.description: Lists Confluence spaces with their keys. Read-only. Call this before filtering pages or comments by space, rather than guessing a space key from its display name.

keys.description: Specific space keys to fetch, or null for all spaces

function.name: list_confluence_pages
function.description: Searches Confluence pages by space, text, and recency. Read-only. Returns titles, authors, excerpts, and links, not bodies; follow up with get_confluence_page. Set mine_only for the user's own pages.

space_keys.description: Space keys from list_confluence_spaces, or null for all spaces

text.description: Free text to match in title and body, or null

modified_within_days.description: Only pages modified within this many days, or null

mine_only.description: True to keep only pages the connected account created or owns

function.name: get_confluence_page
function.description: Reads one Confluence page's body as plain text. Read-only. Use the numeric page ID returned by list_confluence_pages or list_confluence_comments; long pages are truncated.

function.name: list_confluence_comments
function.description: Lists recent Confluence comments with author, timestamp, excerpt, and a link that opens the comment in place. Read-only. Set only_my_pages for "comments on my docs": pages the user wrote or owns.

space_keys.description: Space keys from list_confluence_spaces, or null for all spaces

within_days.description: How many days back to look, or null for the last day

only_my_pages.description: True to keep only comments on pages the connected account created or owns
